messages:
alex: Quick note — noticed ~15% p95 latency regression on Mixtral-8B in hosted last night for long chat templates. Perf profiler points to KV cache misses + extra kernel switch.

jamie: Logs? rough timeline?

alex: root cause trace: tokenization falling back to byte-level for some unicode emojis and special markers -> token counts increase, hitting batcher threshold, causing kernel picker to switch from fused-attn to byte-fallback kernels at step ~20. pasted snippet:
```
[profiler] kernel_switch: fused_attn -> byte_fallback at step 22
[kv_cache] miss_rate: 0.27 -> 0.61
[latency] p95: 180ms -> 210ms
```

kim: Interesting — RoPE phase scaling might amplify the switch cost for long seqs. Are we using rope scaling hook for Mixtral in the runtime config?

alex: Yes, runtime uses linear RoPE scaling for Mixtral-8B but kernel selection logic doesn't take scaled RoPE into account; fused_attn expects original step sizes so it falls back.

nina: Could this be head-dim mismatch between model config and kernel heuristics? We had a similar mismatch for Qwen where head_dim % 8 caused non-vectorized path.

jamie: Can you paste the model config that fired?

alex: snippet:
```
model: mixtral-8b
heads: 32
head_dim: 64
rope_scaling: {type: linear, factor: 1.5}
tokenizer: byte_fallback=true
```

kim: Two thoughts: 1) adjust kernel picker so that rope_scaling enables fused_attn variant that supports scaled phase (cheap fix). 2) relax batching thresholds to avoid re-routing on single token spikes.

nina: Also check KV cache warmup heuristic — when batching coalesces multiple short chats into one request we seem to flush prefix KV and reinit which increases miss rate. Maybe prefetch common prefix vectors into per-model LRU.

ops-bot: deploy:perf-canary started for mixtral-8b-rope-fix (canary 10% hosts)

jamie: I'll prototype a kernel attribute 'rope_compatible' and add it to model manifest; runtime kernel picker will prefer those when rope_scaling != none.

alex: Thanks. Also adding a small prompt rewrite step to normalize special markers (strip invisible unicode, unify emoji) to reduce byte fallback. Canary logs will tell.

nina: If this lands, let's add an eval: long-chat-template regen ratio and p95 token latency. Assigning follow-ups:
- jamie: kernel picker change
- alex: tokenizer normalization
- kim: batching threshold tweak

alex: I'll post a baseline perf snapshot once canary runs for 30m.

jamie: ack — ping when canary metrics stable or if false positives show up.
